item.title: Chung Cheong-rae: “If the ‘Home Rabbits’ of Our Support Base Leave, General and Presidential Elections Are Hopeless” (정청래 “지지층 ‘집토끼 집 나가면 총선·대선 무망’ 불안”)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae: “If the ‘Home Rabbits’ of Our Support Base Leave, General and Presidential Elections Are Hopeless” (정청래 “지지층 ‘집토끼 집 나가면 총선·대선 무망’ 불안”)

Chung Cheong-rae, former lawmaker running for the August 17 Democratic Party of Korea convention, said on the 20th, “No matter how many ‘wild rabbits’ you catch, if the ‘home rabbits’ leave the house, the general and presidential elections are hopeless, aren’t they?” Kim Eo-joon, who supported Chung in last August’s party leadership election, recently remarked on the decline in President Lee Jae-myung’s approval ratings, saying, “This is the ‘core’ support base leaving.” Chung also once again mentioned the “core support base” and “home rabbits” today. (8·17 더불어민주당 전당대회에 나서는 정청래 전 대표는 20일 “산토끼를 아무리 잡아 온들 집토끼가 집 나가면 총선·대선은 무망한 것 아닌가”라고 했다. 작년 8월 당대표 선거 때 정 대표를 지원했던 김어준씨는 최근 이재명 대통령 지지율 하락을 두고 “이건 ‘코어(핵심)’ 지지층이 빠진 것”이라고 했었는데, 정 대표도 이날 재차 ‘코어 지지층’ ‘집토끼’ 등을 언급했다.)

In a radio interview on MBC today, Chung cited “a sense of alienation and rebellion among the core support base, the so-called traditional supporters” as his reason for seeking re-election. He said, “I don’t typically use such expressions (like core support base). But there is this anxiety, or even fear, among the supporters.” (정 전 대표는 이날 MBC라디오 인터뷰에서 연임 도전 이유로 “핵심 코어 지지층, 소위 전통적 지지층 이반 현상과 상실감이 있다”며 “저는 그런(코어 지지층 등) 표현을 잘 쓰지 않는다. (하지만 지지층 사이에서) 이런 불안감 내지 심하게 말해 공포감 같은 게 있다”고 했다.)

Chung added, “For victory in the general and presidential elections, these people must firmly hold the Democratic Party together, but I’m seeing signs of cracks, and it seems to be gradually turning me into a crusader.” He said, “So I’ve developed a sense of mission.” (정 전 대표는 “총선 승리, 대선 승리를 위해서는 이분들이 굳게 민주당을 지키고 있어야 하는데 균열 조짐이 좀 보이고 그것이 저로 투사가 점점 되는 것 같다”며 “그래서 일종의 사명감이 생겼다”고 했다.)

He continued, “There were requests for me to step up and ‘make the Democratic Party more democratic.’” Citing the “one-person-one-vote system” and “prosecutorial reform” as his mottos, Chung said, “There are actual movements trying to shake the one-person-one-vote system,” and “Party members genuinely believe that if Chung Cheong-rae does not become party leader, the one-person-one-vote system could be abolished or destabilized, and they are highly vigilant about that.” (이어 “‘민주당을 민주당답게 만드는 데 정청래가 나서 달라’ 이런 요청이 있었다”고 했다.정 전 대표는 ‘1인1표제’와 ‘검찰개혁’을 모토로 들고 “1인1표제를 흔들려 하는 움직임이 실제로 있다”며 “(당원들은) 정청래가 당 대표가 되지 않으면 1인1표제가 폐지될 수도 있다, 흔들릴 수도 있다는 생각을 실제로 하고 있고 거기에 대한 경계심이 대단하다”고 했다.)

He said, “The prosecutorial reform has passed the 90% mark,” but added, “If the supplementary investigation authority is not completely abolished, setting up the Appeals Office and Major Crimes Investigation Office is pointless.” (그는 “검찰개혁 부분이 9부 능선을 넘었다”면서도 “보완수사권이 전면 폐지되지 않으면 실제로 공소청·중수청은 하나 마나”라고 했다.)

He added, “The tail can wag the whole body—this anxiety is widespread among party members.” In particular, he said, “I sat through the recent general meeting of lawmakers from start to finish, and I was truly flustered and shocked. The overwhelming majority very naturally and assertively argued that the supplementary investigation authority should not be abolished.” He said, “Lawmakers, too, feel that an incomprehensible situation is unfolding, as do many party members.” (이어 “10%의 꼬리로 몸통 전체를 흔들 수 있다, 이런 불안감이 실제로 당원들에게 많이 있다”고 했다.특히 “최근 의총에 제가 처음부터 끝까지 앉아 있었는데 너무 당황스럽고 놀랐다. 너무나 자연스럽고 당당하게 보완수사권 폐지는 안 되는 것 아니냐 이런 주장을 절대다수가 한다”고 했다. 그는 “도대체 알 수 없는 상황이 벌어지고 있다고 의원들도 느끼고 당원들도 많이 느낀다”고 했다.)

Chung also argued that the candidate deposit for the party convention should be lowered to last year’s level and that a “public system” should be introduced, funded by the party, to support candidates’ campaigns. (또 정 전 대표는 당대회 후보 기탁금을 지난해 수준으로 낮추고, 당 재정으로 후보들의 선거운동을 지원하는 ‘공영제’를 도입해야 한다고 주장했다.)

He said, “I didn’t realize the deposit had increased this much. I only found out recently. I think it’s too high, so I hope it can be lowered to last year’s level, back to the previous level.” (그는 “기탁금이 이렇게 많이 올라간 지 몰랐다. 최근에 알았다”며 “제가 봐도 너무 많아서 작년 전당대회 수준으로, 이전 수준으로 낮췄으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

He continued, “Looking back at my time as party leader, the Democratic Party actually has plenty of money—with a balance of tens of billions of won,” adding, “Since President Lee Jae-myung also proposed something akin to a public election system, I hope the party can cover the costs.” (이어 “당 대표 때 (보니까) 실제 민주당에 돈이 많다. 잔고가 몇백억원이 있다”면서 “(이재명) 대통령께서도 선거공영제에 준하는 것을 하자고 했으니 당에서 부담을 했으면 좋겠다”고도 했다.)

Regarding the so-called “rebuilding theory” recently raised by Yoo Si-min, Chung said, “No comment,” and added, “Each person can judge for themselves. Adding my own words to that could cause more problems. It’s not appropriate for me, as a former party leader, to comment on Mr. Yoo’s remarks or on the president’s matters.” (그는 유시민씨가 최근에 제기한 이른바 재건축론에 대해선 “노코멘트하겠다”라며 “각자 알아서 판단할 몫이지 제가 거기에 말을 덧붙여 하는 것은 여러 가지 문제를 더 야기할 수 있다. (유씨) 말이나 대통령 관련 말은 당 대표를 지낸 사람으로서 언급하는 것은 적절하지 않다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Eo-jun YouTube: Ruling Party's Judiciary Committee Members Push for "Abolition of Prosecution's Supplementary Investigation Powers Before Party Convention" (김어준 유튜브서 與 법사위원들 “檢 보완수사권 폐지 전당대회 전 통과 추진”)
item.description:
Kim Eo-jun YouTube: Ruling Party's Judiciary Committee Members Push for "Abolition of Prosecution's Supplementary Investigation Powers Before Party Convention" (김어준 유튜브서 與 법사위원들 “檢 보완수사권 폐지 전당대회 전 통과 추진”)

National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chairman Seo Young-kyo of the Democratic Party of Korea and Kim Seung-won, the party's secretary on the committee, appeared on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel on the 20th, stating they would continue to push for the complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. The committee is currently deliberating on a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act to eliminate these powers. Although recent events surrounding the "Jang Yoon-gi case" have heightened negative public sentiment toward the complete abolition, leading to cautious voices within the Democratic Party, the committee chairman and the ruling party's secretary simultaneously took a hardline stance. <<> That day, three lawmakers from the broader opposition bloc on the Judiciary Committee—Chairman Seo, Representative Kim Seung-won, and Representative Park Eun-jung of the Jo Kuk Innovation Party—appeared together on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel. <<> Chairman Seo and others dismissed the likelihood of passing a recently proposed revision to the Criminal Procedure Act by 11 lawmakers, including Democratic Party Representative Hong Ki-won, which aimed to retain some of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. Chairman Seo stated, "Since the prosecution's investigative powers were already removed when the Public Prosecution Office Act was created, that can be considered the party's official stance," effectively blocking internal dissent. <<> One panelist remarked, "Listening to the opposing side (maintaining supplementary investigation powers) is pointless. If we've decided to go ahead, we must move forward," and no lawmaker raised any objections. <<> During the broadcast, when Kim asked, "Is the likelihood of passing a bill without supplementary investigation powers before the party convention still high?", Democratic Party secretary Kim Seung-won replied, "We aim to focus and move quickly toward that goal (passing the bill to abolish supplementary investigation powers). We need to finalize the structure, including articles, within this week." <<> Representative Park Eun-jung also said, "The extraordinary session runs until August 5, so it must pass in the plenary session before that. We need to finish the subcommittee this week and get through the full committee next week." Kim pressed, "Time is critical. Please wrap it up by the end of July." <<> Kim Eo-jun offered to help expedite the legislative process, saying, "Let me know what I can do to assist," and "Let's regularly tune into the Judiciary Committee. I'll help drive this discussion." Chairman Seo responded, "When we receive briefings, please help spread the word," and "Push through with full force." (더불어민주당 소속 서영교 국회 법제사법위원장과 민주당 법사위 간사인 김승원 의원 등이 20일 김어준씨 유튜브 채널에 나와 검찰 보완수사권 완전 폐지를 계속 추진하겠다고 밝혔다. 법사위는 검찰 보완수사권 폐지를 위한 형사소송법 개정안을 심사 중이다. 최근 ‘장윤기 사건’을 계기로 보완수사권 완전 폐지에 대한 부정적 여론이 커지자 민주당 내에서도 신중론이 일고 있지만, 위원장과 집권 여당 간사가 동시에 강경 입장을 밝힌 것이다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Kang Kyung-hwa’s Sudden Return Shows the Crisis in the ROK-U.S. Alliance" (장동혁 “강경화 급거 귀국, 한미동맹 위기 그대로 보여줘”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "Kang Kyung-hwa’s Sudden Return Shows the Crisis in the ROK-U.S. Alliance" (장동혁 “강경화 급거 귀국, 한미동맹 위기 그대로 보여줘”)

People Power Party Representative Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 20th, "The sudden return of South Korean Ambassador to the U.S. Kang Kyung-hwa clearly reveals the crisis in the ROK-U.S. alliance." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 20일 “강경화 주미 한국대사의 급거 귀국은 한미동맹의 위기를 그대로 보여준다”고 말했다.)

In a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Representative Jang said, "The people cannot trust the Lee Jae-myung regime’s defense and security policies. Even the ROK-U.S. alliance, a pillar of security, is in crisis." (장 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “국민은 이재명 정권의 국방 안보 정책을 믿지 못하고 있다. 안보의 한 축인 한미동맹까지 위기”라며 이같이 말했다.)

Previously, Ambassador Kang had temporarily returned to South Korea on the 15th to discuss pending issues in Korea-U.S. relations—such as the Coupang case and investment in the U.S.—with the presidential office and others. Upon her return, she met with Foreign Minister Cho Hyun and the following day attended a standing committee meeting of the National Security Council (NSC) at the presidential office. She then returned to the U.S. on the 19th. (앞서 강 대사는 지난 15일 쿠팡 문제와 대미 투자 등 한·미 관계 현안에 대해 청와대 등과 논의하기 위해 일시 귀국했다. 강 대사는 귀국 직후 조현 외교부 장관과 면담하고, 이튿날 청와대 국가안전보장회의(NSC) 상임위원회에도 참석했다. 이후 19일 미국으로 복귀했다.)

Representative Jang also said, "Nevertheless, this regime is pushing for an early transfer of wartime operational control. They also claim they will pass the law for integrating military academies within this year." He added, "If the military weakens and the ROK-U.S. alliance falters, only North Korea’s Kim Jong-un regime will benefit. National security is not a matter of ideology, politics, or experimentation." (장 대표는 “그런데도 이 정권은 전시작전통제권 조기 전환까지 밀어붙일 태세다. 사관학교 통합도 올해 안에 법까지 다 통과시키겠다고 한다”며 “군이 약해지고 한미동맹이 흔들리면 좋아할 사람은 북한 김정은 정권밖에 없다. 국가 안보는 이념의 대상도, 정치의 대상도, 실험의 대상도 아니다”라고 했다.)

He also mentioned the special counsels launched by the Lee Jae-myung administration, stating, "The four political special counsels of the Lee Jae-myung regime reportedly spent 6.4 billion won on real estate alone. They secured expensive office spaces in Gangnam and Gwanghwamun and spent hundreds of millions on luxury interiors." He added, "All of this is at the expense of the people’s tax money." (그는 또 이재명 정부에서 출범한 특검들을 언급하며 “이재명 정권의 4대 정치 특검이 부동산 비용만 64억원을 썼다고 한다. 강남과 광화문에 임대료 비싼 사무실을 얻고 몇억 원씩 들여서 초호화 인테리어까지 했다”며 “모두 국민의 혈세”라고 했다.)

He further argued, "Let’s stop the political special counsels and start a people’s special counsel (regarding the National Election Commission scandal). Only a people’s special counsel—recommended by the People Power Party, with unlimited scope of investigation—can restore the stolen right to vote and uphold the Constitution of the Republic of Korea." (그러면서 “정치 특검 그만하고 (선관위 사태에 대한) 국민 특검 하자”며 “국민의힘 추천, 수사 범위 무제한, 국민 특검만이 빼앗긴 참정권을 회복하고 대한민국의 헌법을 수호하는 길”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating Drops Slightly to 48.4%…"Support Base Defects Amid Ruling Party Conflict" (李대통령 지지율 소폭 내려 48.4%…“與갈등에 지지층 이탈“)
item.description:
President Lee's Approval Rating Drops Slightly to 48.4%…"Support Base Defects Amid Ruling Party Conflict" (李대통령 지지율 소폭 내려 48.4%…“與갈등에 지지층 이탈“)

A poll released on the 20th showed that President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for his state affairs has slightly declined. According to a survey conducted by Realmeter on behalf of Energy Economy News from the 13th to the 16th among 2,007 people aged 18 and over nationwide, the positive evaluation of the President's performance stood at 48.4%, down 0.5 percentage points from the previous week. (이재명 대통령의 국정수행 지지도가 소폭 하락했다는 여론조사 결과가 20일 나왔다. 리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난 13∼16일까지 전국 18세 이상 2007명을 대상으로 조사한 결과 이 대통령의 국정수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 지난주보다 0.5%포인트 내린 48.4%였다.)

Negative evaluations rose by 0.3 percentage points to 48.0% compared to last week. The gap between positive and negative ratings was 0.4 percentage points, within the margin of error (at a 95% confidence level with ±2.2 percentage points). The proportion of those who responded 'don't know' was 3.6%. (부정 평가는 지난주 대비 0.3%p 오른 48.0%였다. 긍정·부정 격차는 오차범위(95% 신뢰 수준에 ±2.2%포인트) 내인 0.4%포인트였다. ‘잘 모름’이라고 응답한 비율은 3.6%였다.)

Realmeter stated, "Early and mid-week, positive evaluations remained in the early 50% range," but added, "In the latter part of the week, economic headwinds such as interest rate hikes and a stock market plunge, along with conflicts within the ruling party over supplementary investigative powers and writer Yoo Si-min's 'inevitable failure' remarks, caused the core support base—those in their 40s and progressives—to largely defect, leading to a significant drop in approval ratings, and overall positive evaluations ended with a slight decline." (리얼미터는 “주 초·중반에는 긍정 평가가 50% 초반대를 유지했다”면서도 “주 후반 금리 인상·증시 급락 등 경제 악재와 여권 내 보완수사권 갈등, 유시민 작가의 ‘필연적 실패’ 발언까지 겹치면서 핵심 지지층인 40대와 진보층이 주로 이탈하며 지지율이 상당 폭 하락해 전체 긍정 평가는 소폭 내림세로 마감했다”고 했다.)

By region, Daejeon, Sejong, and Chungcheong saw the largest decline, down 13.8 percentage points to 38.1%. Busan, Ulsan, and Gyeongnam (43.7%) and Seoul (43.7%) also dropped by 6.0 percentage points and 1.3 percentage points, respectively, compared to the previous week. In contrast, Daegu and Gyeongbuk (46.9%) rose by 15.7 percentage points, showing the largest increase. South Jeolla, Gwangju, and North Jeolla (79.7%) rose by 5.9 percentage points. (지역별로는 대전·세종·충청이 13.8%포인트 내린 38.1%로 가장 큰 하락 폭을 보였다. 부산·울산·경남(43.7%)과 서울(43.7%)도 각각 지난주보다 6.0%포인트, 1.3%포인트 하락한 것으로 조사됐다. 반면 대구·경북(46.9%)은 15.7%포인트 오르며 지지율 상승 폭이 가장 컸다. 전남광주·전북(79.7%)은 5.9%포인트 올랐다.)

In a separate party support survey conducted by Realmeter on the 15th and 16th among 1,005 people aged 18 and over nationwide, the Democratic Party of Korea recorded 43.1% and the People Power Party 40.0%. The Democratic Party dropped by 1.7 percentage points from the previous survey, while the People Power Party rose by 1.9 percentage points. The Democratic Party's support rate fell for the first time in five weeks, and the People Power Party rebounded for the first time in five weeks. Regarding this, Realmeter said, "Ahead of the Democratic Party's national convention, factional conflicts over the introduction of a preferential voting system and internal disagreements over the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers were highlighted in the media, leading to a decline in support among those in their 50s and 60s and progressives." (리얼미터가 지난 15∼16일 전국 18세 이상 1005명을 대상으로 한 정당 지지도 조사에서는 더불어민주당이 43.1%, 국민의힘이 40.0%였다. 민주당은 지난 조사 대비 1.7%포인트 떨어졌고 국민의힘은 1.9%포인트 올랐다. 민주당 지지율은 5주 만에 하락, 국민의힘은 5주 만에 반등했다. 이에 대해 리얼미터는 “민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 선호투표제 도입을 둘러싼 계파 갈등과 검찰 보완수사권 폐지론에 대한 당내 이견이 언론을 통해 부각되면서 50대·60대와 진보층을 중심으로 지지율이 이탈했다”고 했다.)

Regarding the People Power Party, it said, "The party pushed for the proposal of the 'Three Laws for Crime Victim Protection' as a party platform following the Jang Yun-ki murder case, emphasizing the maintenance of supplementary investigative powers and enhanced enforcement, which appears to have consolidated the support base and led to a rebound." (국민의힘에 대해서는 “장윤기 살인 사건을 계기로 ‘범죄피해자 보호 3법’ 당론 발의를 추진하며 보완수사권 유지 및 단속 강화 메시지를 부각한 것이 지지층 결집으로 이어져 반등한 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

Both surveys were conducted via wireless automated response. The margin of error for the presidential approval rating survey was ±2.2 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 4.0%. The party support survey had a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 4.1%. For more details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website. (두 조사는 모두 무선 자동응답 방식으로 이뤄졌다. 대통령 국정수행 지지도 조사의 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±2.2%포인트, 응답률은 4.0%였다. 정당 지지도 조사 응답률은 표본오차 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%포인트, 응답률은 4.1%였다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Koh Min-jung: “The 86-Generation Banner Must Change… ‘Legitimate Lineage Controversy’ Disappointing, It’s a Reliance on Someone” (고민정 “86세대 간판 바꿔야...‘적통 논란’ 실망, 누구에게 기대려는 모습”)
item.description:
Koh Min-jung: “The 86-Generation Banner Must Change… ‘Legitimate Lineage Controversy’ Disappointing, It’s a Reliance on Someone” (고민정 “86세대 간판 바꿔야...‘적통 논란’ 실망, 누구에게 기대려는 모습” )

Koh Min-jung, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea who is running for party leader in the August 17 national convention, said on the 20th, “I want to change the 86-generation banner through myself,” adding, “Although my influence is weak, many people within the Democratic Party are also expressing frustration.” Regarding the recent “legitimate lineage debate” within the party, Rep. Koh stated, “Talking about who I am closer to or claiming to be the rightful heir actually emphasizes one’s lack of roots.” (8·17 더불어민주당 전당대회 당 대표로 출마한 고민정 더불어민주당 의원은 20일 “저로 인해 86세대 간판을 바꾸고 싶다”며 “힘이 약하긴 하지만 민주당 내부에서 조차도 갑갑함 호소하는 사람 많이 있다”고 했다. 고 의원은 최근 당내 ‘적통 논쟁’에 대해 “스스로가 ‘나는 누구랑 더 가깝다’ ‘나야말로 적자다’라고 얘기하는 것이 오히려 자신의 뿌리 없음을 강조하는 것”이라고 했다.)

In an interview on the YouTube channel “Politics Signal” that morning, Rep. Koh said, “Even if it ends up being like throwing an egg against a rock, I intend to see it through to the end,” and expressed hope that “the public and party members would help create change within the Democratic Party.” (고 의원은 이날 오전 유튜브 채널 ‘정치시그널’ 인터뷰에서 “바위에 계란을 묻히는 정도로 끝난다고 하더라도 끝까지 해볼 생각”이라며 “국민들도 당원도 민주당의 변화를 만들어주셨으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

When asked, “What made you furrow your brow the most?”, Rep. Koh replied, “It’s the so-called legitimate lineage controversy. No one is curious about who’s in whose line. The public looks at a person’s political career and understands them as that kind of politician.” (고 의원은 ‘제일 눈살이 찌푸려졌던 것이 무엇인가’라는 질문에 “그야말로 적통 논란이다. 누가 누구 라인인지 아무도 궁금하지 않다”며 “국민들은 그 사람의 정치 이력을 쭉 보면서 저런 정치인이구나 이해한다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh noted, “People and party members, seeing this legitimate lineage dispute drag on, have been quite critical.” She added, “The three (Kim Min-seok, Chung Cheong-rae, Song Young-gil) are truly heavyweight politicians who could be presidential contenders. They should be doing their own politics with their own colors, but they keep trying to lean on someone...” She continued, “They may be older and have long political careers, but they don’t seem to have the same spirit as younger people. It’s somewhat disappointing.” (고 의원은 “사람들이, 당원들이 자꾸 적통 논란이 계속되는 모습을 보면서 굉장히 좀 질책을 많이 하시더라”라며 “(김민석·정청래·송영길) 세 분은 그야말로 대권 주자급 거물 정치인들이지 않나. 본인의 색깔로 본인의 정치를 하셔야 되는 분들인데 자꾸만 누구에게 기대려고 하는 모습이...“라고 했다. 이어 ”연세는 많이 들었고 정치적 이력도 많지만 젊은 사람들만큼의 패기도 없는 것 같다. 좀 실망스럽다”고 했다.)

Regarding the criticism that former Representative Chung Cheong-rae recently showed a defensive stance, saying, “Being hit two-to-one or three-to-one hurts a lot. Please go easy,” and adopting an underdog strategy, Rep. Koh stated, “It’s not something he should be so hurt about. In the local elections, many candidates were unknown to both the public and party members. From their perspective, even though they were hit not 1-to-3 but with a weight of 1-to-100 or 1-to-1000, they respected and accepted it because it was the party’s decision. So, shouldn’t he be rallying, managing, and empathizing with those people?” (최근 정청래 전 대표가 최근 “2:1, 3:1로 두들겨 맞으면 많이 아프다. 살살 해달라”고 수세적 태도를 보이면서 ‘언더독(약자)’ 전략을 쓰고 있다는 지적에 대해선 “(정 전 대표가) 그것을 너무 아파할 일은 아니지 않나. (지방선거에서) 이름조차 국민과 당원들은 알지 못 하는 후보들이 많이 있다”며 “그분들 입장에선 1대3이 아니라 1대100, 1대1000 무게감으로 맞았음에도 당의 결정이니까 존중하고 받아들였다. 그럼 (정청래 전 대표는) 그런 분들을 추스르고 다스리고 공감해주는 것이 필요하지 않나”라고 했다.)

She added, “They often say things like, ‘He’s hurting from being hit 1-to-3, but we couldn’t even voice our pain anywhere. We had to accept it because the party decided, and the wounds haven’t healed yet. So, it’s hard to sympathize.’” (이어 ”그분들이 ‘(정 전 대표가) 1대3으로 맞아서 아프다고 하지만 저희들은 어디다 아프다는 소리도 못 내봤다’ ‘당이 결정했기 때문에 받아들여야만 했고 아직도 상처가 치유되지 않았다. 그래서 공감이 잘 안 된다’ 이런 말씀들을 많이 하신다”고 했다.)

On the discussion about abolishing the prosecution’s supplementary investigation powers, Rep. Koh said, “Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, as a former prime minister, should take responsibility.” The Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister’s Office stated in a June position paper, “The goal of reforming the criminal justice system should be to protect the rights and interests of the people and realize criminal justice,” adding, “Limited supplementary investigation by prosecutors is still necessary.” Rep. Koh argued that Former Prime Minister Kim needs to provide a detailed explanation on this. Recently, after expressing a stance that partial retention of the prosecution’s supplementary investigation powers is necessary, Rep. Koh said she has been receiving a barrage of text messages from hardline supporters. (검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 논의에 대해선 “김민석 전 총리가 전직 총리이기 때문에 책임져야 한다”고 했다. 국무총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단은 지난 6월 발표한 입장문에서 “형사사법 체계 개혁의 목표는 국민의 권익 보호와 형사정의 실현이어야 한다”며 “검사의 보완수사는 제한적으로나마 필요하다”고 했었다. 이에 대한 김 전 총리의 자세한 설명이 필요하다는 것이다. 고 의원은 최근 검찰 보완수사권의 부분적 존치가 필요하다는 입장을 최근 밝히면서 강성 지지층으로부터 문자 폭탄을 받고 있다고 했다.)

Regarding the controversy over the nomination deposit for the national convention candidates, Rep. Koh commented, “It’s understandable that those outside the party might raise issues, but for those inside the party who have even served as lawmakers to suddenly raise their voices over this is highly hypocritical and duplicitous. The convention preparatory committee has always made decisions like this. So, they should have taken steps earlier to streamline this committee itself.” (전당대회 후보자 기탁금 논란에 대해 고 의원은 “원외에 계신 분들이 문제 지적하는 것은 충분히 그럴 수 있는데 원내에 계시고 국회의원도 하셨던 분들이 갑작스럽게 이것을 가지고 목소리를 높이는 것은 굉장히 이율 배반적이고 표리부동한 모습”이라며 “늘 전당대회준비위원회에서 이렇게 결정을 해왔다. 그럼 이 전준위 자체를 앞으로 확 당길 수 있게끔 (미리) 손을 봤어야 한다”고 했다.)

In response to the People Power Party’s criticism that President Lee Jae-myung’s mention of the Democratic Party’s convention deposit constituted “interference in party affairs,” Rep. Koh said, “The People Power Party seems to have gotten it wrong. Selecting public officials and internal party elections are different matters.” However, she added, “The fact that the president had to speak so publicly about this suggests there might be a problem in the political affairs line. I’m curious about the reason.” <<>> (이재명 대통령의 민주당 전당대회 기탁금 언급을 두고 ‘당무 개입’이라고 비판한 국민의힘에 대해선 “국민의힘이 잘못 짚은 것 같다. 공직자를 선출하는 것과 당 안의 선거는 다른 문제”라고 했다. 다만 “대통령이 저렇게 공개적으로 할 수밖에 없는 것은 정무 라인에 문제가 생긴 것 아닌가 (생각한다). 이유가 무엇인지 궁금하다”고도 했다)

item.title: People Power Party Calls Rival’s Push to Abolish Supplementary Investigation Rights a 'Constitutional Tribute to Hardcore Supporters' (국힘, 與 ‘보완수사권 폐지’에 “개딸에 바치는 헌정 입법”)
item.description:
People Power Party Calls Rival’s Push to Abolish Supplementary Investigation Rights a 'Constitutional Tribute to Hardcore Supporters' (국힘, 與 ‘보완수사권 폐지’에 “개딸에 바치는 헌정 입법”)

The People Power Party (PPP) on the 20th criticized the Democratic Party of Korea’s move to abolish supplementary investigation rights, calling it "a constitutional tribute to its extremist support base, the 'Gaettal'" and urging them to "stop the one-way rampage to privatize legislative power and destroy the criminal justice system." (국민의힘은 20일 더불어민주당의 보완수사권 폐지 추진에 대해 “극성 지지층인 ‘개딸’에게 바치는 헌정 입법”이라며 “입법권을 사유화해 형사 사법 체계를 파괴하려는 일방통행식 폭주를 멈추라”고 했다.)

PPP Senior Spokesperson Park Sung-hoon said in a statement on the same day, "If they insist on abolishing supplementary investigation rights without justification, the Democratic Party has failed to provide any answer on who would verify the sloppiness of police investigations or where the cycle of repeated investigative delays would end." (국민의힘 박성훈 수석대변인은 이날 논평에서 “보완수사권을 무작정 폐지하겠다면, 경찰 수사의 부실을 대체 누가 확인하고 반복되는 수사 지연을 어디서 끝낼 것인지 민주당은 그 어떤 답도 내놓지 못하고 있다”면서 이렇게 말했다.)

Park added, "Candidate hopefuls for the Democratic Party leadership, conscious only of the votes of their hardline supporters, are still chanting the abolition of supplementary investigation rights like parrots. Even President-elect Lee Jae-myung cannot evade responsibility. The silence of standing by while the majority of the public expresses concern and legal experts oppose such legislation cannot serve as a shield to dodge accountability." (박 대변인은 “민주당 당권 주자들은 강성 지지층의 표심만 의식한 채 여전히 보완수사권 폐지를 앵무새처럼 외치고 있다”며 “이재명 대통령도 책임을 피할 수 없다. 국민 다수가 우려하고 법조계와 전문가들이 반대하는 법안을 방관하는 침묵은 결코 책임을 면해주는 방패가 될 수 없다”고 했다.)

He continued, "The Democratic Party’s push to abolish supplementary investigation rights is now nothing more than a destruction of the criminal justice system 'of the Democratic Party, by the Democratic Party, for the Democratic Party,' and a constitutional tribute solely to its extremist supporters, the 'Gaettal.' The only purpose of this legislative rampage, devoid of both measures and justification, is to provide a bulletproof shield for the regime and engage in reckless retaliation against the prosecution." (이어 “이제 민주당의 보완수사권 폐지는 ‘민주당의, 민주당을 위한, 민주당에 의한’ 형사 사법 체계 파괴이자, 오직 극성 지지층인 ‘개딸’에게 바치는 헌정 입법이 되었을 뿐”이라며 “대책도 명분도 없는 입법 폭주의 목적은 오직 하나, 정권을 향한 방탄과 맹목적인 검찰 보복뿐”이라고 했다.)

He further stated, "We urge them to halt the one-way rampage aimed at privatizing legislative power and destroying the criminal justice system, and to deliberate from the people’s perspective. If they insist on ending up with an uncontrollable state of lax investigations, they will inevitably face the stern judgment of public opinion." (그러면서 “입법권을 사유화해 형사 사법 체계를 파괴하려는 일방통행식 폭주를 멈추고 국민의 눈높이에서 숙고하기 바란다”며 “부실 수사의 통제 불능 상태를 끝내 자초한다면, 반드시 민심의 준엄한 심판을 받게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

PPP Senior Deputy Floor Leader Choi Soo-jin also said in a statement on the same day, "According to a Gallup Korea poll, even among Democratic Party supporters, support for 'maintaining' supplementary investigation rights (46%) outpaces 'abolishing' them (39%). Even the Democratic Party’s own base is demanding a halt to this judicial amendment that only benefits criminals and large law firms." (국민의힘 최수진 원내수석대변인도 이날 논평에서 “한국갤럽 조사 결과, 민주당 지지층조차 보완수사권 ’유지(46%)’가 ’폐지(39%)’를 앞질렀다”며 “민주당 지지층마저 범죄자와 대형 로펌만 웃게 할 사법 개악을 멈추라 명령하고 있다”고 했다.)

Choi added, "The Democratic Party leadership hopefuls should take this warning from their own base seriously and immediately stop their reckless vote calculations. The PPP will fight to the end against the Democratic Party’s aggression that threatens the lives of the people and the rule of law." (최 대변인은 “민주당 당권 주자들은 안방의 경고를 무겁게 받아들여 무모한 표 계산을 당장 멈추라”며 “국민의힘은 국민의 생명과 법치주의를 위협하는 민주당의 폭거에 맞서 끝까지 싸우겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Teachers 'Copy-Paste' School Records… Poor Management and Unfair Deletion of Bullying Records (생기부 ‘복붙’한 교사들… 학폭 기록은 부실 관리, 부당 삭제)
item.description:
Teachers 'Copy-Paste' School Records… Poor Management and Unfair Deletion of Bullying Records (생기부 ‘복붙’한 교사들… 학폭 기록은 부실 관리, 부당 삭제)

An audit by the Board of Audit and Inspection revealed that several schools in Seoul have poorly managed or unfairly deleted school violence-related records. It also found that high school teachers have been copy-pasting the same content into the school life records of multiple students. (서울 소재 여러 학교가 학교폭력 관련 기록을 부실하게 관리하거나 부당하게 지운 것으로 감사원 감사 결과 드러났다. 고등학교 교사들은 여러 학생의 학교생활기록부에 같은 내용을 ‘복사·붙여넣기’ 해온 것으로 나타났다.)

◈Poor Management of Counseling Records That Serve as Bullying Evidence… Unfair Deletion of Action Records Also Found (◇학교폭력 증거 되는 상담 기록 관리 부실… 조치 기록 부당 삭제도)

According to a regular audit report on the Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education released by the Board of Audit and Inspection on the 20th, during the 2023-2025 academic years, the highest number of school violence cases occurred in schools under the jurisdiction of the Seoul Gangnam-Seocho District Office of Education and the Gangseo-Yangcheon District Office of Education, which were handled by the School Violence Countermeasures Deliberation Committee. When the Board reviewed 155 serious cases out of 2,649 cases deliberated by the committees of these two district offices during this period, they found that in 143 cases (92.2%), the schools did not keep counseling records for students and thus failed to submit them to the committee. <<> Consequently, in some cases, the claims of victimized students were not accepted. In one case where a student was bullied by nine individuals, the victim had consulted with their homeroom teacher five times over two years, from August 2023 to August 2025, but the teacher and school failed to record or store the counseling content. As a result, they could not submit the counseling records even upon the committee's request, and only part of the harm claimed by the victim was recognized. <<> The committees themselves were also failing to properly document their deliberations. According to the School Violence Prevention Act, committees are required to keep minutes detailing the meeting date, location, attending members, discussion content, and resolutions. The Ministry of Education manual further stipulates that what each member said during discussions must also be recorded in the minutes. <<> However, when the Board reviewed the minutes of committees belonging to 11 district offices of education in Seoul, it found that discussion content was not being recorded, and only statements from involved parties, such as the perpetrators, and the final resolutions were documented. The Board pointed out, "It is difficult to verify what deliberation process led to the committee's decisions on measures against perpetrators, making it challenging to ensure the fairness and equity of committee deliberations." <<> The committees were also inconsistent in evaluating perpetrators' actions. In one case, a perpetrator's continuity was rated 'low' because the recording and sending of illegal videos occurred within a single day, whereas in another case, a perpetrator who assaulted and recorded another student within a day but sent the video on a different day received a 'medium' rating for continuity. Furthermore, 36.9% of perpetrators showed no willingness to reconcile, yet their reconciliation intent was rated 'high', and 33.3% showed no remorse, yet their degree of remorse was rated 'high'. <<> Additionally, some schools misunderstood regulations on recording school violence in student records, deleting the records of certain perpetrators on their graduation day instead of retaining them for two years post-graduation. <<> The Board notified the Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education to "develop measures to record and manage counseling outcomes so that counseling content between students and teachers can be used as evidence in committees, and ensure that individual members' discussion points are recorded in the minutes of committee decision-making processes." It also directed that nine teachers who unfairly deleted school violence records be issued warnings. <<> ◈'Copy-Paste' in Detailed Activity Records and Comprehensive Opinions of Student Records <<> Among 315 high schools in Seoul, in 239 schools where student records are used for college admissions, 15,377 subject teachers wrote identical content in the 'Detailed Activity Record' section for at least two students each. In 236 high schools, 1,604 homeroom teachers wrote identical content in the 'Comprehensive Opinion' section for at least two students each. <<> 803 teachers wrote the same content for more than 50 students each in the 'Detailed Activity Record' section. For example, one science teacher wrote identical content for all 260 students' detailed activity records in 2021. Another science teacher wrote the same content for 115 students taking chemistry in 2021, 69 students taking integrated science in 2023, and 114 students taking scientific inquiry experiments. <<> 76 teachers created 2-5 'versions' and reused them. One science teacher created two versions in 2021, using one for 235 students and the other for 59. The following year, they created three versions for 148, 132, and 54 students respectively. <<> One social studies teacher reused a single version over multiple years. This teacher wrote the same content for 86 students in 2021, 100 the following year, 77 in 2023, and 73 in 2024. There were also cases where a successor teacher copied content written by a predecessor for dozens of students. <<> Homeroom teachers also often created several versions of comprehensive opinions for their classes of around 20 students, rather than writing unique ones for each student. One public high school teacher responsible for a class of 19 third-year students in 2024 created seven versions of comprehensive opinions, using each for 2-3 students. A private high school teacher with a class of 21 third-year students in 2024 created five versions and distributed them based on student numbers. For instance, one version was used for students numbered 3, 3+5=8, 3+5+5=13, and 3+5+5+5=18, while another was used for students 4, 4+5=9, 4+5+5=14, and 4+5+5+5=19. Only two students out of 22, numbers 6 and 17, received individually written comprehensive opinions. The Board confirmed that 18 homeroom teachers each wrote identical comprehensive opinions for over 70% of their class students. <<> The Board notified the Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education to "ensure the credibility of student records is not undermined by investigating the number and extent of duplicate entries and work conditions of teachers who wrote duplicate content for multiple students, and taking appropriate action based on the severity of the issue." It also instructed them to "establish specific criteria for duplicate entries in student records, considering subject characteristics and field conditions." (감사원이 20일 공개한 서울교육청 정기 감사 보고서에 따르면, 2023~2025학년도에는 서울 강남서초교육지원청과 강서양천교육지원청 관내 학교에서 학교폭력 사건이 가장 많이 일어나 학교폭력대책심의위원회(학폭위)에서 다뤄졌다. 감사원이 이 기간 두 교육지원청 학폭위에서 심의한 2649건 가운데 사안이 중한 155건을 점검해 보니, 143건(92.2%)은 학교 측에서 학생 상담 기록을 보관하지 않아 학폭위에 제출되지 않았다.)

item.title: People Power Party: “Extension of Second Special Counsel Is Oppression of Opposition and an Extension of a Public Security State” – Launching All-Out Filibuster (국힘 “2차 특검 연장, 야당 탄압이자 공안정국 연장” 필리버스터 총력전)
item.description:
People Power Party: “Extension of Second Special Counsel Is Oppression of Opposition and an Extension of a Public Security State” – Launching All-Out Filibuster (국힘 “2차 특검 연장, 야당 탄압이자 공안정국 연장” 필리버스터 총력전)

The People Power Party on the 20th pushed back against the Democratic Party of Korea’s plan to put the “extension of the second comprehensive special counsel investigation period” to a plenary session vote, calling it “an extension of a public security state aimed at oppressing the opposition.” The People Power Party launched a filibuster (unlimited debate) on this day. (국민의힘은 20일 더불어민주당의 ‘2차 종합특검 수사기간 연장안’ 본회의 처리 방침에 대해 “야당 탄압을 위한 공안정국 연장”이라고 반발했다. 국민의힘은 이날 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 돌입했다.)

People Power Party Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik said of the 30-day extension proposal for the second comprehensive special counsel, “Another name for the re-extension of the second comprehensive special counsel is the oppression of the opposition, an extension of the public security state.” (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 이날 2차 종합특검 30일 연장안에 대해 “2차 종합특검 재연장의 또 다른 이름은 야당 탄압, 공안정국의 연장”이라고 했다.)

Floor Leader Jeong stated, “The second comprehensive special counsel itself is inherently a concept of supplementary investigation into the first three major special counsels. While they claim to abolish the prosecution’s supplementary investigative authority over the police, they are repeatedly extending and re-extending the supplementary investigative special counsel for the special counsel.” He added, “This means they intend to continue the public security state stance centered on the special counsel, rounding up opposition figures with the knife of the special counsel instead of dismantling the prosecution, and oppressing the opposition.” (정 원내대표는 “2차 종합특검 자체가 태생적으로 1차 3대 특검에 대한 보완수사의 개념”이라며 “경찰에 대한 (검찰의) 보완수사권은 폐지하겠다면서 특검에 대한 보완수사 특검은 연장에 재연장을 거듭하는 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “검찰을 해체하는 대신 특검의 칼로 야당 인사들을 대거 잡아들이고 야당을 탄압하는 특검 중심의 공안정국 기조를 계속하겠다는 뜻”이라고 했다.)

Supreme Council Member Shin Dong-uk said, “A regime that began with a special counsel will surely end with a special counsel. What outcomes did the insurrection special counsel and the Kim Keon-hee special counsel produce? It is utterly absurd to extend the second comprehensive special counsel again.” (신동욱 최고위원은 “특검으로 시작한 정권은 반드시 특검으로 막을 내리게 될 것”이라며 “내란특검, 김건희 특검 등이 무슨 성과를 냈느냐. 또다시 2차 종합특검을 연장하는 것은 기가 막힌 일”이라고 했다.)

Youth Supreme Council Member Woo Jae-joon also said, “Since the special counsel began last year, we have been doing nothing but special counsels for an entire year. The comprehensive special counsel has produced virtually no actual results, and most of the belatedly indicted cases have been dismissed. Because there is no problem, no new investigations come up, but the Democratic Party is trying to extend the special counsel until a result emerges.” (우재준 청년최고위원도 “지난해 특검이 시작된 이후 1년 내내 특검만 하고 있다”며 “종합특검은 실제 성과가 거의 없었고 뒤늦게 기소한 사건들도 대부분 기각됐다. 문제가 없기 때문에 새로운 수사가 나오지 않는 것인데 민주당은 결과가 나올 때까지 특검을 연장하려 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Unification Ministry Reveals Settlement Details: 235.29 Million Won Used for Cheering North Korean Women's Soccer Team (통일부 “北 여자 축구단 응원에 기금 2억 3529만원 사용” 정산 내역 공개)
item.description:
Unification Ministry Reveals Settlement Details: 235.29 Million Won Used for Cheering North Korean Women's Soccer Team (통일부 “北 여자 축구단 응원에 기금 2억 3529만원 사용” 정산 내역 공개)

It has been calculated that a total of 235.29 million won from the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund was spent on event operations and civilian joint cheering activities for the North Korean women's club soccer team "Naegohyang Women's Soccer Team" during their visit to South Korea in May. (지난 5월 북한 여자클럽축구팀 ‘내고향여자축구단’의 방남 기간 행사 운영과 민간 공동응원에 남북협력기금 총 2억3529만원이 쓰인 것으로 집계됐다.)

On the 20th, the Ministry of Unification stated, "During the post-settlement process, we thoroughly verified the execution details through accounting audits and finalized the support amount at 235.29 million won based on actual expenses." The ministry reported the 'Settlement Results of the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund Related to the Participation of the North Korean Athletes' to the National Assembly and released explanatory materials to the press on the same day. (통일부는 20일 “사후정산 과정에서 회계 검증을 통해 집행 내역을 면밀하게 확인하고 실제 소요 경비를 바탕으로 지원 규모를 (2억3529만원으로) 최종 확정했다”고 했다. 통일부는 이날 ‘북한 선수단 참가 관련 남북협력기금 정산 결과’를 국회에 보고하고 언론에도 설명 자료를 냈다.)

According to the Ministry of Unification, 148.74 million won was executed for supporting the joint cheering group organized by civilian groups. The detailed expenditure items for cheering group support include 25.24 million won for ticket purchases (3,048 tickets for the semifinals and 2,000 tickets for the finals), 59.1 million won for cheering supplies and snacks, and 64.4 million won for cheering operations. Of this, the cheering operation costs (64.4 million won) consisted of operating a booth, cheering leadership, service agency fees, and value-added tax. (통일부에 따르면 민간단체들이 추진한 공동응원단 지원 경비로 1억4874만원이 집행됐다. 응원단 지원 경비의 세부 항목별 집행액은 입장권 구매 2524만원(4강전 3048매, 결승전 2000매), 응원용품·간식 5910만원, 응원 진행 6440만원이다. 이 가운데 응원 진행 경비(6440만원)는 운영부스 운영, 응원 리딩, 용역업체 대행 수수료, 부가가치세로 구성됐다.)

The costs incurred during the soccer team's visit to South Korea included 55.91 million won for event operation support and 28.64 million won for safety management support, totaling 84.55 million won. The detailed breakdown of the event operation support costs (55.91 million won) includes rental fees for electronic scoreboards and vehicles, event supplies such as raincoats, and compensation for committee members from civilian groups. Additionally, 2 million won was spent on accounting audits for the subsidy settlement report. (축구단 방남 과정에서 든 비용은 행사 운영 지원으로 5591만원, 안전관리 지원 2864만원 등 8455만원이 투입됐다. 행사 운영 지원 경비(5591만원)의 세부 내역은 전광판·차량 임차료, 우비 등 행사 진행 용품, 민간단체 소속 진행위원 사례비 등이다. 이밖에 보조금 정산보고서 회계검증에 200만원이 지출됐다.)

The Ministry of Unification explained that because it was difficult to predict the scale of civilian cheering group participation in a short time, it provided support in the form of a 'preliminary payment' to the Korea Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Support Association, which handled the civilian cheering group support, by advancing a portion of the estimated project costs, followed by a post-settlement process. (통일부는 민간 응원단의 참여 규모를 단시간에 예측하기 어려워 민간 응원단 지원 실무를 맡은 남북교류협력지원협회에 추정 사업비의 일부를 미리 지급하는 ‘개산금’ 형식으로 지원한 후 사후 정산을 거쳤다.)

The North Korean women's soccer team's participation was suddenly decided about 15 days before the semifinals of the 2025-2026 Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League (AWCL) in early May. As civilian groups centered on inter-Korean exchange and cooperation organizations pushed for joint cheering, the government decided to provide 319.45 million won from the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund, considering that the North Korean soccer team's visit and the civilian groups' cheering would contribute to enhancing mutual understanding between South and North Korea. (북한 여자축구단의 출전은 지난 5월 초 2025-2026시즌 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자챔피언스리그(AWCL) 4강전을 보름 정도 앞둔 시점에서 갑자기 결정됐다. 남북교류협력단체를 중심으로 민간단체들이 공동응원을 추진하자 정부는 북한 축구단의 방남 경기와 민간 단체의 응원이 남북 상호 이해 증진에 기여한다는 점을 고려해 남북협력기금 3억1945만원을 지원하기로 결정했다.)

However, this drew criticism that it was inappropriate for the government to use state funds to support the cheering costs of civilian groups. There was also controversy over fairness, as general spectators individually purchase their own tickets. (하지만 이를 두고 정부가 민간단체의 응원 비용을 정부 예산으로 지원하는건 부적절하다는 지적이 제기됐다. 일반 관중들의 경우 개별적으로 티켓을 직접 구매한다는 점에서 형평성 논란도 일었다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Redevelopment and Reconstruction Are the Master Keys to Supply"... Refutes Presidential Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom's Claim (오세훈 “재개발·재건축, 공급 마스터키”…김용범 靑정책실장 주장 반박)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon: "Redevelopment and Reconstruction Are the Master Keys to Supply"... Refutes Presidential Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom's Claim (오세훈 “재개발·재건축, 공급 마스터키”…김용범 靑정책실장 주장 반박 )

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon stated on the 20th regarding the Lee Jae-myung administration's real estate policy direction that "redevelopment and reconstruction are the 'master keys' that can supply high-quality urban housing." This was interpreted as a rebuttal to Presidential Chief of Staff for Policy Kim Yong-beom's remark that "(redevelopment and reconstruction) are not a universal key." The two are scheduled to meet around next month to discuss housing supply measures. (오세훈 서울시장이 20일 이재명 정부의 부동산 정책 방향과 관련해서 “재개발·재건축은 양질의 도심 주택을 공급할 수 있는 ‘마스터키’”라고 했다. 이는 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 “(재개발·재건축이) 만능 키는 아니다”라고 한 데 대한 반박으로 풀이됐다. 두 사람은 다음 달쯤 만나 주택 공급 방안에 대해 논의할 예정이다.)

On this day, Mayor Oh posted on Facebook, saying, "It is truly regrettable that the Lee Jae-myung administration still holds onto an outdated view that sees (private) redevelopment projects ideologically, as if they were a symbol of speculation," and made the statement accordingly. He further pointed out, "The Lee Jae-myung administration's attitude of falling into dogma and turning away from redevelopment projects is itself the biggest risk that destabilizes the market," adding, "Such short-sightedness, unable to see even an inch ahead, sends a crisis signal to the market that 'there will be no urban apartment supply,' only fueling price instability." <<> Prior to this, on the 19th, Presidential Chief of Staff for Policy Kim Yong-beom said regarding the plan to supply housing through revitalizing redevelopment and reconstruction, "It is not a universal key," and added, "In the short term, redevelopment and reconstruction can actually have the effect of reducing supply, so it is a matter that requires careful decision." This is the argument that redevelopment and reconstruction theoretically take at least 3 to 5 years to result in actual supply. <<> On this day, Mayor Oh did not directly mention Chief Kim but stated, "Redevelopment and reconstruction are the 'master keys' that can supply high-quality urban housing," and added, "That is, provided the government does not obstruct them with outdated ideologies and layers of regulations." He continued, "Seoul is no longer a city with vacant land remaining. It is impossible to secure new development sites indefinitely or keep expanding outward," and added, "Ultimately, housing supply depends on how efficiently we reorganize the existing urban center." <<> Furthermore, Mayor Oh pointed out the limitations of public-led redevelopment projects. He said, "It is natural for the public sector to play a role, but the idea that the public sector should lead everything is an approach that ignores reality," and noted, "We have seen countless cases where plans have been delayed or abandoned due to numerous obstacles, from land acquisition to various administrative procedures." <<> The two individuals, who have revealed differing perspectives on redevelopment and reconstruction, plan to meet around next month to discuss Seoul's housing supply issues. In this regard, Chief Kim had previously stated, "I told Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon that there are many semi-industrial zones in Seoul, such as Yeongdeungpo and Guro, and he went to visit the sites himself," and added, "I expect that if the government and Seoul city collaborate, we can achieve much greater results, and I plan to meet separately with Mayor Oh as well." (오 시장은 이날 페이스북에 “(민간) 정비 사업을 여전히 이념적으로 바라보고 투기의 상징처럼 인식하는 낡은 시각이 이재명 정부에 남아 있어 안타까울 따름”이라면서 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “이재명 정부가 도그마(독단)에 빠져 정비 사업을 외면하는 태도야말로 시장을 불안하게 만드는 최대 리스크”라며 “한 치 앞도 못 보는 단견(短見)이 시장에 ‘도심 아파트 공급은 없다’는 위기 신호를 줘서 가격 불안만 부채질한다”고 지적했다.)

item.title: Invictus Games, the World Sports Festival for Wounded Veterans, to Be Held in Daejeon in 2029 (‘세계 상이군인 체육대회’ 인빅터스 게임, 2029년 대전서 열린다)
item.description:
Invictus Games, the World Sports Festival for Wounded Veterans, to Be Held in Daejeon in 2029 (‘세계 상이군인 체육대회’ 인빅터스 게임, 2029년 대전서 열린다)

Korea is set to host the Invictus Games, the world's sports event for wounded veterans, for the first time in Asia in 2029. (한국이 아시아 국가로는 최초로 세계 상이군인 체육 대회인 ‘인빅터스 게임’을 오는 2029년 개최한다.)

The Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs announced that the British Invictus Games Foundation confirmed Daejeon Metropolitan City as the host city for the 9th Invictus Games, scheduled for October 2029, through a unanimous board vote on the 20th. (영국 인빅터스 게임 재단은 20일 이사회 만장일치 의결로 한국 대전광역시를 2029년 10월에 열리는 제9회 인빅터스 게임 개최지로 확정 발표했다고 국가보훈부가 밝혔다.)

The foundation highly praised Korea's level of preparation, stating as the reason for its selection, "We positively evaluated the systematic progress of preparations based on a close cooperative system between the central government, local government, and the veterans' community under the shared goal of recovery and rehabilitation for wounded veterans." (재단은 한국의 준비 수준을 높이 평가했다며 “중앙정부와 지방정부, 상이군인 사회가 상이군인의 회복과 재활이라는 공동의 목표 아래 긴밀한 협력 체계를 바탕으로 대회 준비를 체계적으로 추진한 점을 긍정적으로 평가했다”고 선정 이유를 설명했다.)

The Invictus Games were founded by the UK's Prince Harry in 2014 to promote the physical, psychological, and social recovery and rehabilitation of wounded veterans through sports. The 2029 event is expected to draw around 3,000 people to Daejeon, including more than 550 wounded veteran athletes from 26 countries and about 1,100 family members. (인빅터스 게임은 영국의 해리 왕자가 스포츠를 통한 상이군인의 신체적·심리적·사회적 회복과 재활을 위해 2014년 창설했다. 2029년 대회에선 26국 상이군인 선수 550여 명과 가족 1100여 명 등 3000여 명이 대전을 찾을 전망이다.)

The Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs expressed its intention to host the 2029 Games following the 2023 event in Düsseldorf, Germany. In December last year, Daejeon, San Diego (USA), and Aalborg (Denmark) were selected as three final candidate cities and have been competing. (보훈부는 2023년 독일 뒤셀도르프 대회를 계기로 2029년 대회 유치 의향을 밝혔고, 지난해 12월 대전과 미국 샌디에이고, 덴마크 올보르가 최종 유치 후보 도시 3곳으로 선정돼 경합해 왔다.)

This was followed by an on-site inspection in February this year, submission of the bid application in May, and a competition presentation last month. During the competition presentation held in London, UK, Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Oh Eul-kwon personally participated to explain Korea's will to host and its capability to hold the event. (이후 올해 2월 현지 실사, 5월 유치 신청서 제출, 지난달 경쟁 프레젠테이션을 거쳤다. 영국 런던에서 진행된 경쟁 프레젠테이션에는 권오을 보훈부 장관 등이 직접 참여해 한국의 유치 의지와 개최 역량 등을 설명했다.)

In particular, it is reported that the government focused on emphasizing South Korea's status as the 'first host in Asia' during the bidding process, stressing the justification for holding the Games in Daejeon. (특히 정부는 유치전 과정에서 ‘아시아 최초 개최’에 중점을 두고 대전 개최의 당위성을 강조해 온 것으로 전해졌다.)

Minister Kwon stated at a press conference in May, "We are emphasizing that for the entire Invictus Games to spread worldwide, it is crucial that the Games be held in Asia for the first time." (권 장관은 지난 5월 기자간담회에서 “아시아에서 처음으로 게임이 열려야 인빅터스 게임 전체가 전 세계로 확산할 계기가 된다는 점을 강조하고 있다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

item.title: Korea National Diplomatic Academy Hacked for 10 Months, "Difficult to Specify Leaked Details" (국립외교원, 10개월간 교육시스템 해킹 “유출 내역 특정 어려워”)
item.description:
Korea National Diplomatic Academy Hacked for 10 Months, "Difficult to Specify Leaked Details" (국립외교원, 10개월간 교육시스템 해킹 “유출 내역 특정 어려워”)

The Korea National Diplomatic Academy (KNDA), under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, was found to have been hacked for approximately 10 months. (외교부 산하 국립외교원이 약 10개월간 해킹을 당한 것으로 드러났다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated on the 20th, "In early February of this year, after being notified by relevant agencies of abnormal access to the KNDA's online education system, we urgently blocked the system." (외교부는 20일 “올해 2월 초 국립외교원 온라인교육시스템에 대한 비정상적 접근 상황을 관계 기관으로부터 통보받은 후 해당 시스템을 긴급 차단했다”고 밝혔다.)

Investigations revealed that an unidentified attacker exploited deficiencies in the system's security settings to take control of the server around April-May of last year, and based on this, maintained access until February of this year. The hacking persisted for approximately 10 months. (조사에 따르면 미상의 공격자는 시스템 보안 설정 미비점을 이용해 지난해 4~5월 서버를 장악했고, 이를 토대로 올해 2월까지 접속한 것으로 파악됐다. 약 10개월간 해킹이 이어진 것이다.)

The Ministry added, "This attack exploited a 'zero-day vulnerability' that even the software manufacturer was unaware of at the time. After gaining access, the attacker utilized normal software permissions, making detection difficult through conventional methods." "At that point, no security updates were available to patch this vulnerability, limiting our response capabilities." A 'zero-day vulnerability' refers to a security flaw that emerges before the software developer has prepared a patch. (외교부는 “이번 공격은 소프트웨어 제조사도 당시 인지하지 못했던 ‘제로데이 취약점’을 악용해 접속한 후 정상적인 소프트웨어 권한을 이용했기 때문에 일반적인 방법으로는 탐지가 어려웠다”며 “해당 시점에는 이를 보완하기 위한 보안 업데이트가 제공되지 않아 대응에 한계가 있었다”고 했다. ‘제로데이 취약점’은 소프트웨어 개발사 등도 해당 패치를 마련하지 않은 상황에서 발생하는 보안 약점을 의미한다.)

The hacked online education system server reportedly stored educational videos and information necessary for educational operations, such as trainees' names and IDs. The Ministry stated, "As of now, it is difficult to specify the details of what was leaked." (해킹된 온라인교육시스템 서버에는 교육 동영상, 교육 대상자의 성명·아이디 등 교육 운영에 필요한 정보가 저장돼 있었다고 한다. 외교부는 “현재로서는 유출 내역을 특정하기 어려운 상황”이라고 했다.)

The system has been blocked since February this year, when the hack was first detected, and a ministry official said they are continuing investigations with relevant agencies. (해당 시스템은 해킹이 처음 포착된 지난 2월부터 현재까지 차단된 상태로, 관계 기관과 함께 조사를 이어가고 있다고 관계자가 전했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] KFA World Cup Observation Team Skipped Czech Republic Match... 450 Million Won for a 'Mexican Cultural Tour' ([단독]축구협 월드컵 참관단, 체코전 패싱... 4억5000만원짜리 ‘멕시코 문화탐방’)
item.description:
[Exclusive] KFA World Cup Observation Team Skipped Czech Republic Match... 450 Million Won for a 'Mexican Cultural Tour' ([단독]축구협 월드컵 참관단, 체코전 패싱... 4억5000만원짜리 ‘멕시코 문화탐방’)

It was confirmed on the 20th that half of the local itinerary for the 'World Cup observation team' dispatched to Mexico by the Korea Football Association (KFA) consisted of cultural tours. The observation team, sent to Mexico for an 11-day, 9-night schedule, was found to have not attended the match against the Czech Republic, where the South Korean national team secured its only victory. Most of the 16 members of the observation team are described by football insiders as 'key supporters' of former KFA president Chung Mong-gyu's successful bid for a fourth consecutive term. <<> According to the '2026 North and Central America World Cup Observation Team Schedule' submitted by the KFA to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Kim Seung-soo, four out of the eight days spent in Guadalajara and Monterrey, Mexico, were filled with 'World Cup facility and cultural tours.' The observation team's official schedule for attending World Cup matches included four games: South Korea vs. Mexico on June 18, Tunisia vs. Japan on June 20, South Korea vs. South Africa on June 24, and the United States vs. Türkiye on June 25. <<> The observation team's schedule did not include attending the match against the Czech Republic on June 11, which was South Korea's first game. The World Cup observation team thus missed the only match the South Korean team won in this tournament. Regarding this, the KFA reportedly explained to the National Assembly, "If we had attended the first match (Czech Republic) as well, the observation team's stay in the local area would have been too long, so it was not included in the schedule." <<> The total cost for the KFA to dispatch the World Cup observation team to Mexico for the 11-day, 9-night schedule from June 17 to June 27 was 450 million won. This came from the association's own budget, equating to approximately 28.12 million won in public funds per observer. In a written response submitted to the National Assembly regarding the rationale for dispatching the team, the KFA explained, "The purpose was to allow KFA delegates to directly observe the World Cup site, thereby verifying international football operations trends and tournament management cases," adding, "This helps enhance understanding necessary for promoting the KFA's major policies and projects." <<> KFA delegates hold considerable influence over the election of the KFA president. Indeed, in the election held in February of last year, presidents of regional football associations publicly declared their support for former president Chung. <<> However, of the 16 members of this World Cup observation team, 11 were presidents of regional football associations. The remaining members consisted of two KFA vice-presidents and one president of the University Football Federation. There were only two working-level KFA staff members. <<> Seo Kang-il, president of the Jeonbuk State Football Association, who was part of the World Cup observation team in Mexico, sparked controversy in an interview with KBS on the 16th by saying, "What do Park Ji-sung and Lee Young-pyo know to speak recklessly?" Targeting former national team players Park Ji-sung and Lee Young-pyo, President Seo remarked, "How much life have they lived, how much law do they know, and how much social experience do they have to become the innovation committee chairman and members?" adding, "Instead of just criticizing, they should run for the KFA presidential election themselves." <<> Regarding former president Chung, he said, "He's not someone who should be criticized this much," and "People call it his '13-year rule,' but I consider it '13 years of sacrifice.'" <<> A parliamentary hearing of the KFA by the National Assembly's Culture, Sports, and Tourism Committee is scheduled for the 30th. People Power Party lawmaker Kim Seung-soo stated, "The World Cup observation team was essentially a pleasure trip for the key supporters who backed former President Chung's re-election," and asked, "I want to question the KFA whether pouring 450 million won of the association's public funds into their 'Mexican cultural tour' is indeed normal operations." He added, "We must use this opportunity to scrutinize not only the process of appointing former national team coach Hong Myung-bo but also the KFA's overall backroom operations." <<> (대한축구협회가 멕시코에 파견한 ‘월드컵 참관단’의 현지 일정 절반이 문화탐방이었던 것으로 20일 확인됐다. 9박11일 일정으로 멕시코에 파견된 월드컵 참관단은 우리 대표팀이 1승을 거뒀던 체코전은 관람하지 않았던 것으로 나타났다. 16명의 참관단 대부분은 정몽규 전 대한축구협회 회장의 4선 연임 ‘공신(功臣)’이라는 것이 축구계 평가다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil: "Blue House Won't Deal with Jeong Cheong-rae if He Becomes Leader" (송영길 “靑, 정청래 대표되면 상대 안 해”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil: "Blue House Won't Deal with Jeong Cheong-rae if He Becomes Leader" (송영길 “靑, 정청래 대표되면 상대 안 해”)

Rep. Song Young-gil, running in the Democratic Party's August 17th national convention, claimed on the 20th that if rival candidate former Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae wins, the Blue House will not acknowledge him, causing problems in the party-presidential office relationship. Tensions between pro-Moon and pro-Jeong candidates are escalating a day before the primary preliminary race. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회에 출마하는 송영길 의원은 20일 당권 경쟁 주자인 정청래 전 대표가 당선될 경우 청와대가 정 전 대표를 인정하지 않으면서 당·청 관계에 문제가 생길 것이라고 주장했다. 전당대회 예비경선을 하루 앞두고 친명·친청 후보간 신경전이 고조되고 있다.)

In a YouTube channel interview that day, when asked by the host, "Could problems arise in the party-presidential office relationship if former Rep. Jeong (wins re-election)?", Rep. Song said, "Of course they will. They won't deal with the party leader. They'll work with the floor leader instead." This raised the so-called 'Jeong Cheong-rae bypass theory.' Rep. Song added, "Didn't I call him a stalker? It's like a friend (President Yoon) says he doesn't want to see you (Jeong) anymore, but (you) keep calling saying you love him." (송 의원은 이날 한 유튜브 채널 인터뷰에서 ‘정 전 대표가 (재선) 되면 당·청 관계에 문제가 생길 수 있는가’라는 진행자 질문에 “당연히 생긴다. 당대표를 상대 안 할 것”이라며 “(정 전 대표 대신) 원내대표하고 일을 할 것”이라고 했다. 이른바 ‘정청래 패싱론’을 제기한 것이다. 송 의원은 “내가 (정 전 대표를) 스토커라고 그러지 않았나. 친구(이 대통령이)가 이제 너(정 전 대표) 그만 만나고 싶다고 그러는데 계속 사랑한다고 전화 오고 그런 것이지 않나”라고도 했다.)

Rep. Song also claimed that some supporters of the People Power Party are backing Jeong. "Today, Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk made a statement supporting Jeong. In actual polls, Jeong has the highest approval among People Power Party supporters," Song said, adding, "Isn't there such a thing as tactical voting?" (송 의원은 국민의힘 지지층 일부가 정 전 대표를 지지하고 있다고도 주장했다. 송 의원은 “오늘도 장동혁 대표가 정 전 대표를 지지하는 발언을 했다. 실제 여론조사에서 보면 국민의힘에서 가장 지지도가 높은 사람이 정 전 대표”라며 “역선택이라는 게 있지 않나”라고 했다.)

He said, "People Power Party supporters could easily come in and support Jeong, judging that it helps maintain their party's support." The Democratic Party will announce the final candidates on the 23rd after conducting online voting and polls targeting central committee members and paid party members (70%) and the general public (30%), implying that in the general public survey, People Power Party supporters might deliberately vote for Jeong. (그는 “얼마든 국민의힘 지지자들이 들어와서 정 전 대표를 지지하는 게 국민의힘 지지 유지에 도움이 된다고 판단해 지지할 수 있는 것”이라고 했다. 민주당은 중앙위원·권리당원(70%), 일반 국민(30%)을 대상으로 온라인 투표·여론조사를 진행한 뒤 23일 본경선 진출자를 발표하는데, 일반 국민 조사 등에서 국민의힘 지지층이 일부러 정 전 대표에게 투표할 수 있다는 취지다.)

Regarding the June 3rd local elections, where the party failed to retake the Seoul mayoral seat, Rep. Song said, "(It) revealed a stark difference in perception between (Jeong) and President Yoon." He added, "He says he did his best, but given the situation, he could have taken a step back. Instead, he drew his sword to fight the president and declared a frontal confrontation." <<>> (송 의원은 이번 서울시장 탈환에 실패한 6·3 지방선거 결과에 대해서도 “(정 전 대표와) 이 대통령과의 현격한 인식 차이가 드러났다”며 “본인은 열심히 했다고 하지만 상황이 이렇게 되면 한 발 쉴 수도 있을 텐데 굳이 대통령과 싸우겠다고 칼을 빼서 정면 대결을 선언한 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Appoints Budget Office Director Cho Yong-beom as New Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance (李대통령, 신임 기획예산처 차관에 조용범 기획예산처 예산실장 임명)
item.description:
President Lee Appoints Budget Office Director Cho Yong-beom as New Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance (李대통령, 신임 기획예산처 차관에 조용범 기획예산처 예산실장 임명)

President Lee Jae-myung appointed Cho Yong-beom, head of the Budget Office at the Ministry of Strategy and Finance, as the new Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance on the 20th. (이재명 대통령이 20일 신임 기획예산처 차관에 조용범 기획예산처 예산실장을 임명했다.)

Senior Presidential Secretary Kang Yoo-jung announced the selection of the new Deputy Minister Cho in a written briefing on the same day, stating, “New Deputy Minister Cho is a top expert in the budget and fiscal sectors, having held key positions such as head of the Budget Office.” She added, “In particular, he is recognized for contributing to stability in people’s livelihoods and economic recovery by passing the supplementary budget for overcoming the Middle East war crisis in the first half of this year within the shortest possible time and exceeding the fiscal execution target.” (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑을 통해 조 신임 차관 인선을 밝히며 “신임 조 차관은 예산실장 등 핵심 보직을 두루 거친 예산·재정 분야 최고 전문가”라며 “특히 올해 상반기 중동전쟁 위기극복 추경을 최단기간 내 통과시키고, 재정집행 목표를 초과 달성하는 등 민생안정과 경기 회복에 기여한 것으로 평가받고 있다”고 했다.)

Senior Secretary Kang further said, “Based on his expertise in budget and finance, he is expected to establish mid- to long-term national development strategies and support Korea’s great leap forward through investment in future-oriented response strategies such as AI.” (강 수석대변인은 그러면서 “예산·재정 전문성을 토대로 중장기 국가 발전 전략을 수립하고, AI 등 미래 대응 전략 투자를 통해 대한민국 대도약을 뒷받침할 것으로 기대된다”고 했다.)

item.title: South Korea-US-Japan Foreign Ministers' Meeting... Reunion in Manila on the 22nd After Two Weeks (한미일 외교장관 회의... 22일 마닐라서 2주만에 재회)
item.description:
South Korea-US-Japan Foreign Ministers' Meeting... Reunion in Manila on the 22nd After Two Weeks (한미일 외교장관 회의... 22일 마닐라서 2주만에 재회)

The foreign ministers of South Korea, the United States, and Japan will hold a trilateral meeting on the 22nd, on the sidelines of the ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations)-related foreign ministers' meetings, to discuss North Korea cooperation and regional affairs. This comes about two weeks after they last met on July 7 (local time) in Ankara, Turkey, on the margins of the NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) summit. (한·미·일 외교장관이 22일 아세안(ASEAN·동남아시아국가연합) 관련 외교장관 회의 참석을 계기로 3국 장관 회의를 개최하고 대북 공조와 역내 정세 등을 논의한다. 지난 7일(현지 시각) 튀르키예 앙카라에서 나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구) 정상회의를 계기로 한·미·일 외교장관 회의를 가진 이후 약 2주 만이다.)

According to the South Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the U.S. State Department on the 20th, South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi are scheduled to hold a foreign ministers' meeting in Manila, Philippines, on the 22nd. (20일 한국 외교부와 미국 국무부에 따르면 조현 외교부 장관과 마코 루비오 미국 국무장관, 모테기 도시미쓰 일본 외무상은 오는 22일 필리핀 마닐라에서 외교장관 회의를 개최할 예정이다.)

Key agenda items for this foreign ministers' meeting are expected to include security issues on the Korean Peninsula, as well as regional and global affairs, and economic security cooperation. Attention is also focused on whether there will be any mention regarding China's territorial claims in the South China Sea. (이번 외교장관 회의에서는 한반도 안보 현안을 비롯해 지역·글로벌 정세, 경제안보 협력 등이 주요 의제로 다뤄질 것으로 예상된다. 중국의 남중국해 영유권 주장과 관련한 언급이 나올지도 주목된다.)

Minister Cho will also attend the South Korea-ASEAN, ASEAN+3 (South Korea, China, Japan), ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF), East Asia Summit (EAS), and South Korea-Mekong foreign ministers' meetings, held in Manila from the 22nd to the 23rd. (조 장관은 22∼23일 마닐라에서 열리는 한-아세안, 아세안+3(한·중·일), 아세안지역안보포럼(ARF), 동아시아정상회의(EAS), 한-메콩 외교장관 회의에도 참석한다.)

Additionally, during the meeting period, he is scheduled to hold bilateral foreign ministers' talks with Australia, Thailand, New Zealand, Brunei, and the Philippines. Bilateral meetings with major countries such as the United States, Japan, and China are also being coordinated. (또 회의 기간 호주, 태국, 뉴질랜드, 브루나이, 필리핀 등과 양자 외교장관 회담을 가질 예정이다. 미국·일본·중국 등 주요국과도 양자 회담을 조율 중이다.)

item.title: 'Comprehensive Special Counsel Extension Bill' Tabled at Plenary Session... People Power Party: "Extending Public Security Regime" Filibuster (‘종합특검 연장법’ 본회의 상정…국힘 “공안 정국 연장”필리버스터)
item.description:
'Comprehensive Special Counsel Extension Bill' Tabled at Plenary Session... People Power Party: "Extending Public Security Regime" Filibuster (‘종합특검 연장법’ 본회의 상정…국힘 “공안 정국 연장”필리버스터)

A bill to extend the investigation period of the second comprehensive special counsel, which probes insufficient aspects of three major special counsel probes—insurrection, Kim Keon-hee, and the Marine death—was tabled at a National Assembly plenary session on the 20th, led by the Democratic Party of Korea. (내란·김건희·채해병 등 3대 특검의 미진한 부분 등을 수사하는 2차 종합특검의 수사 기간을 연장하는 법안이 20일 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 본회의에 상정됐다.)

The People Power Party strongly opposed the bill, labeling the re-extension of the comprehensive special counsel as 'oppression of the opposition' and 'an extension of the public security regime,' and launched a filibuster (unlimited debate). Consequently, the bill is expected to be put to a vote on the afternoon of the 21st. (국민의힘은 종합특검의 재연장은 ‘야당 탄압’이자 ‘공안정국의 연장’이라며 법안에 강력히 반발하면서 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 돌입했다. 이에 따라 법안은 21일 오후 표결로 처리될 전망이다.)

The National Assembly convened a plenary session that afternoon and tabled a revised bill on the 'Act on the Appointment of a Special Prosecutor to Investigate the Truth Behind the Insurrection, Treason, and Abuse of State Power by Yoon Suk Yeol and Kim Keon-hee.' (국회는 이날 오후 본회의를 열고 ‘윤석열·김건희에 의한 내란·외환 및 국정농단 행위의 진상규명을 위한 특별검사 임명 등에 관한 법률’ 개정안을 상정했다.)

The core of this bill, pushed by the Democratic Party, which holds a majority of seats, is to allow an additional 30-day extension of the comprehensive special counsel's investigation period. Accordingly, if the bill is finalized, the special counsel's investigation deadline would be updated from the 24th of this month to the 23rd of next month. The comprehensive special counsel, launched in February, had its period extended twice under the existing law, and this move seeks another extension. (과반 의석을 차지한 민주당이 추진하는 이 법안은 종합특검의 수사 기간을 추가로 30일 더 연장할 수 있도록 하는 내용이 핵심이다. 이에 따라 법안이 최종 개정되면 특검 수사시한은 오는 24일에서 내달 23일로 갱신된다. 지난 2월 출범한 종합특검은 기존 법에 따라 두 차례 기간을 연장한 바 있는 데 다시 한번 연장하겠다는 것이다.)

The bill also includes adding 'obstruction of audits' by public officials related to the cases as a target of the special counsel's investigation, and expanding the number of government officials dispatched to the special counsel from the current 130 to 150. (법안에는 특검 수사 대상으로 사건들에 관한 공무원의 ‘감사 방해’ 행위를 추가하고, 특검 파견 공무원 수를 현행 130명에서 150명으로 확대하는 내용 등이 담겼다.)

It also includes a provision to designate up to 10 special investigators with at least five years of legal experience as prosecutors to maintain indictments, tasked with upholding charges filed by the special counsel. (법조 경력을 5년 이상 보유한 특별수사관 중 10명 이내를 공소유지 변호사로 지정해 특검이 기소한 사건의 공소 유지를 담당하도록 하는 내용도 포함됐다.)

The bill adds a new clause requiring the comprehensive special counsel to consult with the existing special counsel teams on matters related to investigations and indictments that could reverse decisions of the three major special counsels or affect the maintenance of indictments. (법안에는 종합특검이 수사·기소와 관련, 3대 특검의 결정을 번복하거나 공소 유지에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 사항에 대해선 기존 특검 측과 협의해야 한단 조문도 신설됐다.)

It also includes a provision that, upon request from the comprehensive special counsel, the three major special counsels must provide copies of case records or allow inspection and copying of investigation records. (종합특검의 요구가 있을 경우 3대 특검은 사건기록의 등본을 제공하거나, 수사기록의 열람·복사 등을 허용해야 한다는 내용도 포함됐다.)

The People Power Party requested a filibuster and began unlimited debate immediately after the bill was tabled. Following the National Assembly Act, which allows ending the filibuster with the approval of three-fifths or more of the incumbent lawmakers after 24 hours from its start, the Democratic Party plans to conclude the debate on the afternoon of the 21st and put the bill to a vote. (국민의힘은 필리버스터를 신청하고, 법안 상정 직후 무제한 토론에 돌입했다. 민주당은 필리버스터 시작 뒤 24시간 후 재적의원 5분의 3 이상의 찬성으로 이를 종료할 수 있다는 국회법 규정에 따라 21일 오후 토론을 끝내고 법안을 표결 처리한단 방침이다.)

item.title: Strategic Institute: "Modernization of North Korea-China Alliance... Need to Fully Restore Korea-China Relations" (전략연 “북·중동맹 현대화…한중관계 전면적 복원 해야”)
item.description:
Strategic Institute: "Modernization of North Korea-China Alliance... Need to Fully Restore Korea-China Relations" (전략연 “북·중동맹 현대화…한중관계 전면적 복원 해야”)

As the acceleration of high-level exchanges between North Korea and China signals a modernization of their alliance, a state-run research institute has urged the comprehensive restoration of South Korea-China relations and a strict separation of the Taiwan issue from the Korean Peninsula issue. (북·중 양국 간 고위급 인사 교류 가속화를 통해 북·중 동맹 현대화 움직임을 보이고 있는만큼 한중 관계의 전면적 복원이 시급하고 대만 문제와 한반도 문제를 철저히 분리대응해야 한다는 국책연구기관의 제언이 나왔다.)

In a joint issue brief titled "Modernization of the North Korea-China Alliance: Trends in the Evolution of the North Korea-China Alliance through Recent High-Level Exchanges and Policy Implications," published on the 20th, President Kim Sung-bae and Research Fellow Yoo Hyun-jung of the Institute for National Security Strategy (INSS) stated, "Through the restoration of South Korea-China relations, we must prevent the entrenchment of the bloc confrontation between North Korea, China, and Russia on one side and South Korea, the U.S., and Japan on the other." (국가안보전략연구원(전략연)의 김성배 원장과 유현정 연구위원은 20일 공동으로 집필한 ‘북중동맹의 현대화:최근 북중 고위급 교류를 통해 본 조·중 동맹의 진화 동향 및 정책적 시사점’이라는 제목의 ‘이슈 브리프’에서 “한중관계 복원을 통해 북중러 대 한미일의 진영 대립 고착화를 방지해야 한다”고 했다.)

The report analyzed, "The modernization of the North Korea-China alliance has the character of a strategic response to the modernization of the South Korea-U.S. alliance promoted by the United States, while also being a joint adaptation process by North Korea and China to cope with complex changes in the strategic environment, including the prolonged U.S.-China strategic competition, the deepening of North Korea-Russia military cooperation, and the advancement of North Korea's nuclear capabilities." It added, "The modernization of the South Korea-U.S. alliance, the revival of the North Korea-Russia alliance, and the modernization of the North Korea-China alliance are occurring simultaneously. If the strengthening of North Korea-China relations coincides with the deterioration of South Korea-China relations, China is likely to perceive the Korean Peninsula issue within a framework of confrontation between North Korea-China and South Korea-U.S." (보고서는 “북·중동맹 현대화는 미국이 추진하는 한미동맹 현대화에 대한 전략적 대응 성격을 갖는 동시에 미·중 전략경쟁의 장기화 및 북·러 군사협력 심화, 북한 핵능력 고도화 등 복합적인 전략환경 변화에 대응하기 위한 북·중 양국의 공동 적응 과정”이라고 분석했다. 보고서는 “한미동맹 현대화와 북·러동맹의 부활, 북·중동맹의 현대화가 동시에 진행되고 있다”며 “북중관계 강화와 한중관계 악화가 동시에 진행될 경우 중국이 한반도 문제를 북중 대 한미의 대결 구도로 인식할 가능성이 높아진다”고 했다.)

The report also pointed out the need for a thorough separation of responses to the Taiwan issue and the Korean Peninsula issue. It stated, "If the regionalization of the North Korea-China alliance and the expansion of the South Korea-U.S. alliance's role in the region become intertwined, there is a risk that the Taiwan Strait issue and the Korean Peninsula issue could become militarily linked. South Korea should maintain its principled stance of supporting peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait and opposing unilateral changes to the status quo, but must independently judge specific military intervention issues based on the security situation on the Korean Peninsula, South Korea's constitution and laws, and national interests." (보고서는 또 대만문제와 한반도 문제의 철저한 분리 대응이 필요하다고 지적했다. 보고서는 “북중 동맹의 지역동맹화와 한미동맹의 역내 역할 확대가 맞물릴 경우 대만해협 문제와 한반도 문제가 군사적으로 연계될 위험이 있다”며 “한국은 대만해협의 평화와 안정, 일방적 현상변경 반대라는 원칙적 입장을 유지하되 구체적인 군사적 개입 문제는 한반도 안보상황과 한국의 헌법·법률, 국익에 따라 독자적으로 판단해야 한다”고 했다.)

North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un has clearly expressed support for the 'One China' principle and pledged to uphold China's core interests. The report noted, "This clarifies North Korea's political support on the Taiwan issue. While it does not imply the possibility of direct military intervention by North Korea in the event of a Taiwan contingency, the likelihood of a crisis in the Taiwan Strait and a crisis on the Korean Peninsula becoming interconnected at the level of U.S. military asset allocation and alliance management could increase." (북한 김정은 국무위원장은 ‘하나의 중국’ 원칙을 확고히 지지하고 중국의 핵심 이익 수호를 지원하겠다는 입장을 분명히 한 상태다. 보고서는 “대만 문제에 대한 북한의 정치적 지지를 명확히 한 것”이라며 “대만 유사시 북한의 직접적 군사적 개입 가능성을 의미하는건 아니지만 대만해협 위기와 한반도 위기가 미국의 군사자산 배분 및 동맹 운용 차원에서 상호 연계될 가능성은 커질 수 있다”고 했다.)

Chinese President Xi Jinping, who chose North Korea as his first overseas destination this year, visited Pyongyang in June and held a summit with Chairman Kim Jong-un. In a congratulatory message sent to Kim on the 11th marking the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China treaty, Xi stated that last month's summit had "established the strategic direction and a new blueprint for the development of China-North Korea relations in the new era," and that the bilateral relationship "should make new contributions to consolidating the socialist cause and promoting the modernization construction of both countries." The institute noted, "While the traditional North Korea-China alliance focused on military mutual assistance, the recent cooperation agenda between North Korea and China has expanded to include economy and trade, infrastructure, science and technology, education, culture, tourism, people's livelihoods, and party-to-party exchanges. This indicates that the North Korea-China alliance is evolving into a comprehensive alliance." (올해 첫 해외 방문지로 북한을 택한 시진핑 중국 국가주석은 지난 6월 평양을 방문해 김정은 국무위원장과 정상회담을 했다. 시진핑은 이후 지난 11일 김정은에 보낸 북·중 조약 체결 65주년 기념 축전에서 지난달 정상회담을 통해 “새 시기 중조(중·북)관계 발전의 전략적 방향과 새로운 설계도를 마련했다”며 양국 관계가 “사회주의 위업을 공고히 하고 양국의 현대화 건설을 추진하는 데 새로운 기여를 해야 한다”고 했다. 연구원은 “전통적 북·중동맹이 군사적 상호원조에 중심을 두고 있었던 반면 최근 북·중 간 협력 의제는 경제·무역, 인프라, 과학기술, 교육, 문화, 관광, 민생, 당대 당 교류로 확대되고 있다”며 “북·중 동맹이 포괄적 동맹으로 진화하고 있는 것”이라고 했다.)
